text: Called to make an appointment, needed a new set of nails, apparently they do not remove an old set?

I went to Kay’s Nail today to ask about acrylic nail removal and was surprised to find out they don’t offer that service. I was genuinely confused because most nail salons are able to remove acrylics, especially if clients are planning to get a new set afterward.  The staff was polite, but if you’re looking for a full-service nail salon that includes acrylic removal, this may not be the right fit.
I had such a lovely experience for my gel mani / pedi.  Both technicians were so sweet and brilliant attention to detail.  Very grateful to have found this place.
